name: peartube-monorepo
description: PearTube monorepo - P2P video streaming for desktop and mobile

scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:ebuild --prefix packages/app
scripts.desktop:stage: node -e "throw new Error('Pear OTA staging is not wired for the Electrobun desktop app yet. See docs/pear-runtime-evolution-readiness.md')"
scripts.desktop:release: node -e "throw new Error('Pear OTA release is not wired for the Electrobun desktop app yet. See docs/pear-runtime-evolution-readiness.md')"
scripts.desktop:native: npm run schema:full && npm run build --prefix packages/desktop-native && npm run run --prefix packages/desktop-native
scripts.desktop:native:generate: npm run schema:full && npm run generate --prefix packages/desktop-native
scripts.desktop:native:build: npm run schema:full && npm run build --prefix packages/desktop-native
scripts.schema: cd packages/spec && rm -rf spec/hrpc spec/schema spec/swift-hrpc spec/swift-schema && node schema.cjs
scripts.schema:full: npm run schema && npm run schema:copy-swift
scripts.prepare:mobile-backend: npm run schema && npm run bundle:backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix packages/spec && npm install --prefix packages/backend && npm install --prefix packages/host && npm install --prefix packages/platform && npm install --prefix packages/app --legacy-peer-deps
